title: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
summary: A hip hinge on a fixed bar path that stretches and loads the hamstrings and glutes.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for hamstrings (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.7 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly glutes total.

setup.text: Stand with the bar at your thighs and your feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, keeping the bar against your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, usually just below the knee.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

form_cues.cue: Slide the bar down your thighs
Stand by driving the hips forward
Hips back, not down. Stop where your back would start to round.

mistakes.text: Rounding the back to reach lower.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
